name: Gift Cards
description: TSA rules for gift cards on planes.

carryOn.reason: Gift cards and prepaid cards are fully allowed in carry-on baggage with no restrictions.

checkedBag.reason: Gift cards are allowed in checked baggage.

tsa.pageTitle: Can I bring gift cards on a plane?

travelTips: Gift cards are allowed on planes — keep them in your wallet or carry-on for safekeeping

faq.question: Can I bring gift cards on a plane?
faq.answer: Yes, gift cards are fully allowed in carry-on and checked baggage with no restrictions.

faq.question: Do gift cards need to be declared at customs?
faq.answer: Gift cards generally do not need to be declared unless they represent substantial monetary value — check your destination country's customs rules.
